checks.name: test
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api pytest -q tests

checks.name: lint
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api ruff check . --select F,E9

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api mypy . --ignore-missing-imports
